articles.title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
articles.snippet: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

articles.title: Solana drops ‘beta’ label after more than six years
articles.snippet: The blockchain is getting a shared version number. Wallets, transactions and apps remain unchanged.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin flips to ‘total bull’ on a faster route to quantum-safe Ethereum
articles.snippet: A proposed system would combine bulky digital signatures into a shared proof, helping protect wallets without making every payment much more expensive.

articles.title: Cardano holders vote down $5 million bid to buy warehouse copper
articles.snippet: Toto Finance’s 22 million ADA treasury request expired Sunday with about 20 million ADA in favor, and none of Cardano’s seven constitutional committee members voted yes.

articles.title: Trump administration to name Nvidia, OpenAI and several others as AI national champions
articles.snippet: The Wall Street Journal reported that the move aims to help the firms expand overseas and compete with global rivals, though nothing has been confirmed.
